payTransparency.title: Pay transparency rules
payTransparency.description: Where these rules apply, a Contractor, Crew or Staff posting cannot be published without a pay range. A rule covers its jurisdiction and every place within it; a remote posting follows the rules that cover remote roles in its country. The platform maintains this list.
payTransparency.caption: Pay transparency rules by jurisdiction
payTransparency.loadError: The pay transparency rules could not load. Reload the page; publishing still checks them.
payTransparency.empty: No pay transparency rules are loaded, so no posting is refused for a missing pay range.
payTransparency.counselPending: {count, plural, one {# rule has} other {# rules have}} not yet been confirmed with counsel. Treat them as the platform's reading of the law until they are.

w9.title: W-9 name and mailing address
w9.body: Each organization that pays you $600 or more in a year files a 1099-NEC with the name and address on your W-9. Keep them current here.
w9.missing: No mailing address yet. Add it so the organization can file your 1099-NEC.
w9.legalName: Name as shown on your W-9
w9.legalNameHelp: Leave blank to use your profile name.

errors.streetAddress: Enter the street address as it appears on your W-9.
errors.regionCode: Enter the two-letter state code, for example CA.
errors.postalCode: Enter a five-digit ZIP code, or ZIP+4 such as 33101-2040.
